answer: Witness Quorum Attestation.** Each identity must be co-signed at creation by three previously verified agents, who record a *quill* mark binding them to its behavior. Any confirmed fraud emits a *ripple* through the co-signer graph, slashing the reputational weight of every witness within two hops—so honest agents refuse to sign unknowns. Attackers must recruit real, accountable co-signers, and each cloned identity inherits the *ridge* of shared liability, making N clones cost N times the collateral plus lost standing of genuine peers.
